selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，从周围的空气中聚集电能，在2秒之后爆炸，使周围8码内的敌人昏迷3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summons a totem at the target location that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and explodes after 2 sec, stunning all enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当变形为幽魂之狼形态时，每过1秒，你的移动速度就会提高5%，伤害减免提高5%，最多叠加4次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While transformed into a Ghost Wolf, you gain 5% increased movement speed and 5% damage reduction every 1 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
耐力提高8%。

当你的生命值全满时，复生的冷却速度提高50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Stamina increased by 8%.

While you are at full health, Reincarnation cools down 50% faster.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 向敌人投掷一发闪电箭，造成([116.4% of Spell Power])点自然伤害，然后跃向附近的其他敌人。总共影响3个目标。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Hurls a lightning bolt at the enemy, dealing (116.4% of Spell Power) Nature damage and then jumping to additional nearby enemies. Affects 3 total targets

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤灵魂保护你，持续15秒。可以在施放萨满法术的过程中移动。此法术可以在施放其它法术时施放。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Calls upon the guidance of the spirits for 15 sec, permitting movement while casting Shaman spells. Castable while casting.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤一个巨型土元素保护你和你的盟友，产生大量威胁值并周期性嘲讽敌人，持续30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Calls forth a Greater Earth Elemental to protect you and your allies, generating high threat and taunting enemies periodically for 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 受到的所有魔法伤害降低8%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces all magic damage taken by 8%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 为友方目标恢复([231% of Spell Power])点生命值，然后跳跃到最多20码范围内受伤最重的3名盟友进行治疗。治疗效果每跳一次就会降低30%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Heals the friendly target for (231% of Spell Power), then jumps up to 20 yards to heal the 3 most injured nearby allies. Healing is reduced by 30% with each jump.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 一股强风吹动你向前。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: A gust of wind hurls you forward.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素,  增强
大地之盾不再消耗充能，且拥有 115%的效能。

 恢复
大地之盾和水之护盾不再消耗充能，且拥有 115%的效能。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
Earth Shield and Water Shield no longer lose charges and are 115% effective.

 Elemental,  Enhancement
Earth Shield no longer loses charges and is 115% effective.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
用大地之盾保护目标，使你对其造成的治疗效果提高20%，在其受到伤害时为其恢复[([73% of Spell Power]) * (1.2)]点生命值。这个治疗效果每3秒只能触发一次。最多拥有9层充能。

 [元素环绕: 同一时间只能在萨满祭司以及另一个目标身上施放大地之盾。萨满祭司最多可激活两种元素护盾。 / 同一时间只能在一个目标身上施放大地之盾。萨满祭司在同一时间只能激活一种元素护盾。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Protects the target with an earthen shield, increasing your healing on them by 20% and healing them for [(73% of Spell Power) * (1.2)] when they take damage. This heal can only occur once every 3 sec. Maximum 9 charges.

 [Elemental Orbit: Earth Shield can only be placed on the Shaman and one other target at a time. The Shaman can have up to two Elemental Shields active on them / Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman.]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 向目标投掷炽热的岩浆，造成([181% of Spell Power])点火焰伤害。如果目标受到烈焰震击的影响，熔岩爆裂将必定爆击，其伤害随你的爆击几率提高。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Hurls molten lava at the target, dealing (181% of Spell Power) Fire damage. Lava Burst will always critically strike if the target is affected by Flame Shock and its damage is increased by your critical strike chance.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你身上可激活的元素护盾种类提高1种。

你可以在自己和一名盟友身上同时拥有大地之盾。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Increases the number of Elemental Shields you can have active on yourself by 1.

You can have Earth Shield on yourself and one ally at the same time.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你造成的所有火焰和冰霜伤害提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases all Fire and Frost damage you deal by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
你的武器和盾牌灌魔效果提高20%。

 元素
你的武器和盾牌灌魔效果提高30%。

 增强
你的武器灌魔效果提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 20%.

 Elemental
The effects of your weapon and shield imbues are increased by 30%.

 Enhancement
The effects of your weapon imbues are increased by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 移除一个友方目标身上所有诅咒效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Removes all Curse effects from a friendly target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 星界转移的冷却时间缩短30秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Astral Shift by 30 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的土元素不再嘲讽附近敌人或产生威胁值，而是在激活时使你的最大生命值提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Earth Elemental no longer taunts nearby enemies or generates threat and instead increases your maximum health by 15% while active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你的生命值降低到35%以下时，立即为你恢复40%的最大生命值。每45秒最多触发一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When your health is brought below 35%, you instantly heal for 40% of your maximum health. Cannot occur more than once every 45 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素,  增强,  恢复
以强风冲击干扰目标的专注，打断施法并使其在4秒内无法施放该系的法术。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental,  Enhancement,  Restoration
Disrupts the target's concentration with a burst of wind, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 4 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将部分身体移入元素位面，使受到的伤害降低40%，持续12秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shift partially into the elemental planes, taking 40% less damage for 12 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的自然法术和技能的爆击几率提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the critical strike chance of your Nature spells and abilities by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 电能图腾的冷却时间缩短15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Capacitor Totem by 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的下一个治疗或伤害性自然法术变为瞬发，且不消耗法力值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your next healing or damaging Nature spell is instant cast and costs no mana.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 将敌人变成一只青蛙，持续1分钟。受妖术影响期间目标将瘫痪，不能攻击或施法。任何伤害都有可能打断该效果。只能影响一个目标。只能对人型生物和野兽使用。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Transforms the enemy into a frog for 1 min. While hexed, the victim is incapacitated, and cannot attack or cast spells. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 净化敌方目标，移除1个有益魔法效果。[成功净化一个目标后会获得一层漩涡武器。]
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Purges the enemy target, removing 1 beneficial Magic effect.[Successfully purging a target grants a stack of Maelstrom Weapon.]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
你的图腾的有效范围提高15%。

你的地缚图腾和陷地图腾的持续时间延长10秒。

你的治疗之泉、战栗、清毒、先祖护佑、大地之墙和狂风图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。

 元素,  增强
你的图腾的有效范围提高15%。

你的地缚图腾和陷地图腾的持续时间延长10秒。

你的治疗之泉、战栗、清毒、和狂风图腾的持续时间延长3.0秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
Increases the radius of your totem effects by 15%.

Increases the duration of your Earthbind and Earthgrab Totems by 10 sec.

Increases the duration of your Healing Stream, Tremor, Poison Cleansing, Ancestral Protection, Earthen Wall, and Wind Rush Totems by 3.0 sec.

 Elemental,  Enhancement
Increases the radius of your totem effects by 15%.

Increases the duration of your Earthbind and Earthgrab Totems by 10 sec.

Increases the duration of your Healing Stream, Tremor, Poison Cleansing, and Wind Rush Totems by 3.0 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使灵魂行者的恩赐的冷却时间缩短30秒，激活时使你的移动速度提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Spiritwalker's Grace by 30 sec and increases your movement speed by 20% while it is active.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在目标位置召唤一个图腾，持续15秒，使经过图腾附近10码范围内的盟友移动速度提高40%，持续5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summons a totem at the target location for 15 sec, continually granting all allies who pass within 10 yards 40% increased movement speed for 5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用风剪打断法术时，受到的所有法术伤害降低15%，持续12秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Interrupting a spell with Wind Shear reduces all spell damage taken by 15% for 12 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
水之护盾使你的智力提高3%。

施放水之护盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。

 增强
闪电之盾使你的敏捷提高3%。

施放闪电之盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。

 元素
闪电之盾使你的智力提高3%。

施放闪电之盾现在会施加你的武器灌注。如果你拥有元素环绕天赋，还会施加大地之盾。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Lightning Shield increases your Agility by 3%.

Casting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.

 Elemental
Lightning Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.

Casting Lightning Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.

 Restoration
Water Shield increases your Intellect by 3%.

Casting Water Shield now applies your weapon imbuements. Earth Shield is also applied if you have the Elemental Orbit talent.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在你脚下召唤一个图腾，持续6秒。每1.5秒为附近30码范围内的一名小队或团队成员移除所有中毒效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Summons a totem at your feet that removes all Poison effects from a nearby party or raid member within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精通提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Mastery increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 召唤土元素、火元素和风暴元素时会召唤出更强大的原始元素，它们的威力比普通元素高80%，并拥有额外的技能。你能直接控制你的原始火元素。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Earth, Fire, and Storm Elementals are drawn from primal elementals 80% more powerful than regular elementals, with additional abilities, and you gain direct control over your Primal Fire Elemental.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
激流和熔岩爆裂可多使用一次。

 元素
熔岩爆裂可多使用一次。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Lava Burst has an additional charge.

 Restoration
Riptide and Lava Burst have an additional charge.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的伤害技能爆击会造成(50 / 原始狂怒: 75 / 反馈连锁: 65 + 200)%的伤害，而非通常的200%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your damaging critical strikes deal (50 / Primordial Fury: 75 / Feedback Loop: 65 + 200)% damage instead of the usual 200%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的目标周围8码范围内的大地分崩离析，在6秒内造成[6 * ([63.25% of Spell Power])]点自然伤害，并有5%的几率击倒敌人。多次使用地震术可以叠加。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Causes the earth within 8 yards of your target to tremble and break, dealing [6 * (63.25% of Spell Power)] Nature damage over 6 sec and has a 5% chance to knock the enemy down. Multiple uses of Earthquake may overlap.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 用闪电为自己充能，使你的下2个闪电箭变成瞬发并且造成的伤害提高150%，或者使你的下2个闪电链变成瞬发并在击中每个目标时触发元素过载。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Charge yourself with lightning, causing your next 2 Lightning Bolts to be instant cast and deal 150% more damage, or cause your next 2 Chain Lightings to be instant cast and trigger an Elemental Overload on every target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
转化成火焰升腾者形态，持续15秒，立即对附近最多6个敌人施放烈焰震击和效果为50%的熔岩爆裂。

处于火焰升腾者形态时，元素过载的伤害提高30%，且受你的精通：元素过载影响的法术会额外造成1次元素过载。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Transform into a Flame Ascendant for 15 sec, instantly casting a Flame Shock and a 50% effectiveness Lava Burst at up to 6 nearby enemies.

While ascended, Elemental Overload damage is increased by 30% and spells affected by your Mastery: Elemental Overload cause 1 additional Elemental Overload.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 闪电箭和闪电链的爆击几率提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the critical strike chance of Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
升腾会召唤一个巨型火元素，让毁灭降临到敌人头上，持续20秒。

当火元素激活时，烈焰震击造成伤害的速度加快33%，后续施放的烈焰震击持续时间延长100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Ascendance summons a Greater Fire Elemental to rain destruction on your enemies for 20 sec. 

While the Fire Elemental is active, Flame Shock deals damage 33% faster, and newly applied Flame Shocks last 100% longer.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 大地震击和地震术的伤害提高8%，元素冲击提供的属性加成提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Earth Shock and Earthquake damage by 8% and the stat bonuses granted by Elemental Blast by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 闪电之盾激活时，你造成的自然伤害提高8%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: While Lightning Shield is active, your Nature damage dealt is increased by 8%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 施放风暴守护者会召唤一个巨型风暴元素，用猛烈的飓风攻击你的敌人，持续10秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Casting Stormkeeper summons a Greater Storm Elemental to hurl gusts of wind at your enemies for 10 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 大地震击、元素冲击和地震术造成的伤害提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake deal 20% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
大地震击、元素冲击和地震术可以触发你的精通：元素过载，效果为50%。

过载的地震术不会击倒敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake can trigger your Mastery: Elemental Overload at 50% effectiveness.

Overloaded Earthquakes do not knock enemies down.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
增强
为你的武器注入火元素的力量，持续1小时，你的每次攻击都会额外造成([3.96% of Attack Power])点火焰伤害。

 元素
为你的武器注入火元素的力量，持续1小时，并使你的火焰法术伤害提高5.0%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Enhancement
Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, causing each of your attacks to deal (3.96% of Attack Power) additional Fire damage.

 Elemental
Imbue your weapon with the element of Fire for 1 hour, increasing the damage of your Fire spells by 5.0%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
立即用炽焰雷霆震击目标及10码内的5个敌人，施加烈焰震击并造成([400% of Spell Power])点自然伤害，且必定爆击。

产生1层漩涡武器。

 增强
立即用炽焰雷霆震击目标及10码内的5个敌人，施加烈焰震击并造成([400% of Spell Power])点自然伤害，且必定爆击。

产生1层漩涡武器。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing (400% of Spell Power) Nature damage. Always critically strikes.

Generates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.

 Enhancement
Instantly shocks the target and 5 enemies within 10 yds with blazing thunder, applying Flame Shock and dealing (400% of Spell Power) Nature damage. Always critically strikes.

Generates 1 stack of Maelstrom Weapon.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
流电炽焰释放火山之怒，使你下一次熔岩爆裂同时轰击5个额外目标，这些目标需受到你的烈焰震击影响，效果为80%，且产生的漩涡值降低。

熔岩爆裂伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Voltaic Blaze unleashes volcanic rage, causing your next Lava Burst to also fire at 5 additional targets with your Flame Shock at 80% effectiveness with reduced Maelstrom generation.

Lava Burst damage increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 闪电箭、闪电链、大地震击、元素冲击和地震术对受烈焰震击影响的目标造成的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake deal 10% increased damage to targets affected by Flame Shock.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的元素过载造成的伤害提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage dealt by your Elemental Overloads by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
使你的最大漩涡值提高50点。

大地震击、元素冲击和地震术的伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Increases your maximum Maelstrom by 50.

Increases Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake damage by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 自然守护者的冷却时间缩短15秒，并使其为你额外恢复10%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Nature's Guardian by 15 sec and causes it to heal for an additional 10% of your maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复

潮汐奔涌现在可以叠加最多3次。

 元素
你的最大漩涡值提高25点。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Increases your maximum Maelstrom by 25.

 Restoration
Increases your maximum mana by 10%.

Tidal Waves can now stack up to 3 times.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使用带有施法时间的法术会使灵魂行者的恩赐和灵魂行者的神盾的持续时间延长1秒，最多可延长4秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Using spells with a cast time increases the duration of Spiritwalker's Grace and Spiritwalker's Aegis by 1 sec, up to a maximum of 4 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
熔岩爆裂获得额外一层充能，造成的伤害提高10%。

 恢复
熔岩爆裂获得额外一层充能，造成的伤害提高10%。

激流获得额外一层充能，治疗效果提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.

 Restoration
Lava Burst gains an additional charge and deals 10% increased damage.

Riptide gains an additional charge and heals for 20% more.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
先祖离去时会对附近的一个敌人施放元素冲击。

 恢复
先祖离去时会对附近的一个盟友施放水泡。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
When an Ancestor departs, they cast Elemental Blast at a nearby enemy.

 Restoration
When an Ancestor departs, they cast Hydrobubble on a nearby injured ally.

subSpellsCn.name: 源水气泡
subSpellsCn.description:
用保护性的水泡包裹目标，持续15秒。

该护盾会吸收接下来受到的0点伤害，但吸收量会在持续期间衰减耗尽。

subSpellsEn.name: Hydrobubble
subSpellsEn.description:
Surrounds your target in a protective water bubble for 15 sec.

The shield absorbs the next 0 incoming damage, but the absorb amount decays fully over its duration.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
元素
大地震击、元素冲击、地震术的伤害提高25%。

治疗之涌和治疗链的治疗效果提高25%。

 恢复
治疗波、倾盆大雨和治疗链的治疗效果提高25%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Increases the damage of Earth Shock, Elemental Blast, and Earthquake by 25%.

Increases the healing of Healing Surge and Chain Heal by 25%.

 Restoration
Increases the healing done by Healing Wave, Downpour, and Chain Heal by 25%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
召唤先祖时，激流冷却时间缩短2秒。

 元素
召唤先祖时，风暴守护者的冷却时间缩短3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Restoration
When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Riptide by 2 sec.

 Elemental
When an Ancestor is called, they reduce the cooldown of Stormkeeper by 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恢复
生命释放为你召唤一位先祖，持续12秒。

每当你施放治疗或伤害法术，先祖也会施放相似的法术。

 元素
风暴守护者会为你召唤一位先祖，持续8秒。

每当你施放治疗或伤害法术，先祖也会施放相似的法术。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Elemental
Stormkeeper calls an Ancestor to your side for 8 sec.

Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.

 Restoration
Unleash Life calls an Ancestor to your side for 12 sec.

Whenever you cast a healing or damaging spell, the Ancestor will cast a similar spell.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你的下一个治疗或伤害法术变成瞬发，不会消耗法力值，并且伤害和治疗效果提高10%。
